poses.name: speaking
poses.prompt: Shift her weight onto one leg with the opposite knee relaxed, moving the hips slightly toward screen-right. Turn the torso gently toward screen-left while keeping the face directed toward the viewer. Lean forward a little as if inviting a response. Extend one forearm toward screen-left at lower-chest height with the palm open upward and a clear gap between elbow and waist. Bend the other arm with its hand resting lightly at her waist. Give the shoulders a gentle opposing tilt to the hips. Friendly engaged smile, mouth slightly open, eyes on the viewer.

poses.name: thinking
poses.prompt: Shift the weight onto one leg and turn the torso to a shallow three-quarter angle toward screen-left. Turn the head back toward the viewer so both eyes remain visible, then direct the gaze slightly upward toward screen-right. Bend one arm across the upper waist to support the opposite elbow; raise that forearm with the fingertips resting lightly beneath the chin. Keep the two bent arms readable as a compact triangular shape. Let one shoulder sit slightly higher than the other. Reflective expression, gently drawn brows, closed mouth.
